summary: All 8 features tested and passing. Splash skip (splash faded on its own after ~2s, testID present and clickable when up), theme switching (blue/red/gray/orange) applied to BOTH settings sheet AND home screen (Search Radius value, section icons, slider, SYNC & CONFIRM outline all pick up new accent via onAccentChange rebuild registry), theme persistence in-session reload works via AsyncStorage/localStorage 'theme_id_v1' = 'blue' after selecting blue. Team validation shows/hides testID='team-1-input-warning' for ZZZ vs NYY correctly. Avatars removed from team/show/ticker input rows — only label + input + optional remove button, no 2-letter badge. Sticky button reads 'SYNC & CONFIRM' as expected. All sections (Flight Tracking, Pinned Flight, Weather, Sports, TV Shows, Financial Tickers, Custom Message) render, scroll and no red screens / JS errors. BLE was NOT flagged (native-only).

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' — coming from a dependency (likely reanimated/RN internals in web preview). Non-blocking, cosmetic only.

critical_code_review_comments: /app/frontend/app/index.tsx is 3008 lines — well over the 700-line guideline. Recommend splitting into per-section components (FlightSection, WeatherSection, SportsSection, MessageSection, etc.) for maintainability. Not blocking this round.

Runtime accent theming via mutating shared `colors` object then rebuilding StyleSheet factories works, but relies on all consumers re-rendering after applyAccent. Currently the setTheme call in index.tsx triggers re-render via setThemeId; SettingsSheet re-renders via themeId prop change. Verified visually — both surfaces update. Approach is fine but fragile if new modules cache colors.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Theme accent runtime rebuild works across sheet + home. Verified with radius-value computed color: orange rgb(255,107,0) → blue rgb(47,111,237) → red rgb(229,72,77) → gray rgb(138,143,152) → persists as blue after in-session reload with localStorage 'theme_id_v1'='blue'. Screenshot harness reload preserved localStorage in this run.
